status: frozen before any new-task training or model test evaluation
test_policy: Tuning records never load or evaluate test arrays. All six tasks proceed to all five seeds after validation-only rate selection; tasks and seeds cannot be dropped based on outcomes.
selection_rule: Within method/task, maximize validation accuracy or minimize validation MSE; exact ties choose smaller rate. Incomplete or nonfinite tuning trials are ineligible but retained.
checkpoint_rule: First strictly best validation checkpoint; report both final and validation-selected test metrics after full budget.
architecture: One-layer LSTM with hidden size 64; recurrent 2D core matrices use paired optimizer, output head and recurrent biases use common AdamW. Denoising uses tanh MLP d-64-16-64-d with sigmoid output; all matrices use the paired optimizer.
normalization: Train-only means/std for forecasting and sequence inputs. Digits pixels /16 and raw Olivetti pixels /255, Olivetti average pool 4x4 to 16x16. Denoising training noise sigma .15; frozen validation/test corruption independent of optimizer/seed.
splits: ETTh1/2 target ranges 0:8640,8640:11520,11520:14400, no-overlap 24-step evaluation targets; HAR holds four official training subjects out for validation, official test subjects untouched; FordA holds 20% official training cases out stratified; digits70/10/20 stratified; Olivetti28/4/8 subject split. Split seed42.
family_claim_rule: Every family must complete both tasks and all five method/seed sets. For each task and both references require positive paired 95% t-interval, at least 0.5 percentage point accuracy gain or 1% relative MSE reduction. Family p is maximum of four one-sided paired t p-values (intersection-union); apply Holm across the three planned families at FWER .05. If criteria fail, report mixed/unsupported; never delete outcomes.
